name: Manor ground bay, front door

snap.pivot: the frame's origin (0, 0, 0), a grid point on voxel corners
snap.frame: a wall module: x along the wall from its grid point, left to right seen from outside; y = 0 the wall's centre line, the outside toward -y; z from the ground
snap.place: in the front, behind the porch
snap.turns: quarter turns about the pivot are exact

units: glTF metres, +Y up; the module's pivot is the glTF origin, its frame x east, y north turned to glTF (x, z, -y); a quarter turn anticlockwise seen from above is +90 degrees about +Y
material: point-sampled atlas: base colour, metallic-roughness (metal in B, roughness in G), emission
ambient_occlusion: COLOR_0, linear, multiplies the base colour (1.0, 0.8, 0.64, 0.5 for 0..3 cells), baked on the module alone
